summary: Haiku subagent (agents/review-agent.md) + scripts/run-memory-review.sh helper that proposes 0-3 memory candidates after /z-execute, /z-review-all, or /z-debug; the post-agent review loop and write-through behavior differ by parent_command (z-execute has no interactive accept loop; z-review-all and z-debug do).

entry_points.summary: Haiku subagent definition: role, procedure, output contract, hard rules, slug anti-patterns
Full input field list: parent_command, debug_md_path, artifact primacy rules by parent_command
Six-step candidate generation: read artifacts, scan signals, prefer existing slugs, cap at 3, check tags, debug filter
Fenced JSON schema for candidate objects; any other output treated as malformed
Skip-condition guard and artifact-prep helper; called before every review-agent dispatch
Skip condition: fires when parent_command=debug and DEBUG.md is absent or unreadable
Appends AXIOM_READY <diff_path> to stdout when axioms.auto_extract_post_run != 'false' (read via config.py get)
Helper call, agent dispatch, writes memory-candidates.jsonl + memory_review_complete event; NO interactive accept/skip loop, NO auto /z-suggest-memory dispatch
Helper call, agent dispatch (legacy + INTENT-mode variants), full sequential AskUserQuestion accept/edit/skip loop dispatching /z-suggest-memory on Accept
debug_md_path primary artifact; sequential AskUserQuestion loop; explicit memory_review_terminal emission for ran_empty/needs_user

invariants: subagent never writes; orchestrator owns all writes
skip-conditions check via run-memory-review.sh before any Agent dispatch (cost guard)
hard cap of 3 candidates per run; emit fewer rather than pad
output is exactly one fenced json block; any other output is malformed
agent receives index_path and must prefer extending an existing slug over coining a new one
when parent_command=debug, debug_md_path is primary artifact; spec_path is supplementary only

z-review-all and z-debug run a sequential AskUserQuestion accept/edit/skip loop and dispatch /z-suggest-memory on Accept; z-execute does NOT -- it only writes memory-candidates.jsonl and surfaces N_CANDIDATES via push-notify for later manual review

memory_review_terminal is emitted only by run-memory-review.sh (skip-condition paths, all three parent commands) and explicitly by z-debug Phase 10 for ran_empty/needs_user paths; z-execute and z-review-all instead use phase_end (name: memory_review) as their terminal-state event

AXIOM_READY gated by config key axioms.auto_extract_post_run (read via config.py get); value 'false' suppresses; z-execute Phase 9 (4a), z-review-all Phase 7 (4a), and z-debug Phase 10 (d2) ALL parse and act on it -- not z-debug-only
gotchas: run-memory-review.sh requires $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR to be set; unset yields STATUS: skipped no_plan_dir
run-memory-review.sh soft-skips (exit 0) on missing TAGS.txt rather than failing hard; emits skipped_broken_context state
when parent_command=debug, line 5 of helper stdout is DEBUG.md path; LINES[4] in orchestrator
AXIOM_READY line appears after the standard artifact lines; z-execute Phase 9 (4a), z-review-all Phase 7 (4a), and z-debug Phase 10 (d2) all parse and act on it in parallel with review-agent dispatch

z-execute Phase 9 has NO interactive per-candidate review loop: candidates are written to $RUN_DIR/memory-candidates.jsonl and a memory_review_complete event is emitted, but nothing calls /z-suggest-memory automatically -- a human must review the JSONL and run /z-suggest-memory manually
z-execute logs review_agent_call/review_agent_failed/review_agent_malformed to event target 'orchestration', NOT $RUN -- differs from z-review-all which logs the same event kinds to $RRUN
debug_md_missing skip fires when DEBUG.md absent -- distinct from empty_diff skip
abandoned debug sessions never invoke run-memory-review.sh; no telemetry emitted
empty diff causes skip with skip_reason: empty_diff before any Agent dispatch
diff base ref resolved in order: merge-base(origin/main) -> HEAD~5 -> empty-tree
parse failure on agent return is a soft-skip (review_agent_malformed event) not a hard error
subagent timeout has no per-call wall-clock guard in v1; user ctrl-c is the escape
candidate tags must come from docs/llm/TAGS.txt unless free-form is explicitly justified
review_agent_suggest_failed is logged and iteration continues (not a phase abort); only applies to z-review-all/z-debug's accept loop since z-execute never dispatches /z-suggest-memory

skills/z-execute/SKILL.md, skills/z-review-all/SKILL.md, skills/z-debug/SKILL.md are canonical -- the commands/ directory no longer exists as of the 2026-06-22 rename commit (2731f1d); prior LLM-tier doc still pointed at commands/z-review-all.md and commands/z-debug.md
z-review-all Phase 7 has a separate INTENT-mode dispatch variant passing review_contract: intent and ledger_path: $LEDGER_FILE alongside the legacy-mode dispatch
